item.description: Polkrates #6422 the Twice-Born of the House of Pelorus fell (fell in the war of Burning Lake of Eridanus's freedom). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow to mend. Polkrates has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.

item.description: Euias #835 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (2×). The House of Hyperenor made room at the fire, but no one sat close. Euias has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.

item.description: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Polkrates #6422 the Twice-Born rose from Asphodel and returned to the Field of Ares. Polkrates has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.
